problem: A successful setup save cleared the submitted overlay after a failed invalidation, displaying blank mood although disk had Warm evening host. Copy/switch and workflow status paths relied on the same void response/readback pattern.

decision.frontend: Steve and Elena independently recommend exact canonical committed data over reconstructing normalized workflow fields or treating failed readback as a failed write. Challenge rejects throwOnError-only, especially duplicate copies.
decision.backend: Boris and Nadia independently recommend exact writer transaction snapshot with runtime revision. Root chooses full LocalStateSnapshot plus central monotonic query sharing over partial projection/CAS complexity.
decision.reservation: Revision orders only observed committed/read snapshots. An unseen later commit is unknown when refresh fails; the status error and existing read recovery remain. No latest-disk guarantee is made from an old receipt.
decision.review: Steve and Elena final source reviews find no actionable issue, including inert focused Save guards. Nadia finds none. Boris requested the direct player caller consume its snapshot; root addressed it, and Boris final review finds no new actionable issue. Reviewers use reported checks rather than rerunning them.
decision.ownership: Root implements all files; pairs read-only.

implementation: Storage captures normalized snapshot only after atomic commit and increments runtime revision in the same serialized queue. Existing void wrapper uses this path too; revision is never persisted.

Seven APIs return exact committed snapshots: setup/resume, preparation off, copy, switch, availability, General playback, General transitions. No extra post-write storage read is needed to describe that write.
All affected Stations and General consumers plus direct player save apply only into an existing cache. localState query structural sharing rejects older snapshots from replies or reads.

Existing saved-state refresh, readiness/error gates, draft equality guards and mutation locks remain. Setup Save retains already-owned focus when status becomes unavailable, remains inert via submit guard/aria-disabled, and returns to native disabled after blur.

rows: initial snapshot has runtime revision zero
queued receipts retain their own committed value
disk excludes runtime revision
receipt isolated from storage cache
failed write preserves value and revision
legacy void write participates in same revision sequence
older delayed receipt cannot replace newer cache
older read cannot replace newer cache
absent cache is not seeded by old completion
fresh process reloads saved state with reset runtime revision
setup receipt carries trimmed committed mood and active mirror
setup preserves saved pause and assessment count
explicit resume result clears durable pause
copy receipt includes generated identity and forced-off clean profile
activation receipt names actual target and mirrors it
disable receipt includes saved off and no next check
availability receipt includes synchronized playback disablement
General playback receipt includes canonical preferences
General transition receipt includes canonical timings
rejected profile save preserves revision and current target

native.input: CUA native only; Playwright launches, owns lifecycle and reads passive telemetry. Main IPC result gates hold/fail reads/writes; synthetic localhost catalog, encrypted dummy connection, fresh local state, scheduler stopped and audio muted.
